body:
Phase 4 items 4.5 + 4.6 of docs/specs/pi-native-flush.md (READ IT FIRST). Builds on T26/T27.

=== VERIFIED FACTS ===
- `session_shutdown` event: { reason, targetSessionFile? } — fires on quit/reload/replacement; cleanup-only (no UI guarantees).
- Session tree: `ctx.sessionManager` (read-only: getBranch()/getEntries()/getTree() — entries carry ids; READ the SessionManager types for the exact entry-id field). `ctx.fork(entryId, {position?})` exists ONLY on ExtensionCommandContext (command handlers) — event handlers would deadlock; commands are the fork surface.
- `adlc accept` / `adlc behavior-diff` CLIs exist (P6): see the adlc-prosecute skill and `adlc accept --help` for flags.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. `/adlc-accept <packet.json>` command (lib/commands.mjs): validates the packet path exists; runs `adlc behavior-diff compare` when before/after files are present; shows a ctx.ui.confirm summarizing the ticket + behavior-diff verdict; on approve runs `adlc accept --ticket <id> --packet <path> ... --json` via pi.exec and reports the gate result; on decline or missing inputs, notifies and records nothing. Non-TUI (confirm undefined/false path) → notify and abort.
2. session_shutdown capture: when a ticket is active and the session carries unresolved gate events (denies/reverts newer than the last 'adlc-gate-run' pass or acceptance), append a final 'session-shutdown-open-ticket' evidence entry (session file may be closing — manifest mirror is the durable half; tolerate session-side failure silently). Never blocks shutdown.
3. `/adlc-rollback` command: lists recent fork-eligible entries (from ctx.sessionManager.getBranch(), newest-first, labeled with a short digest — prefer entries adjacent to recorded gate events), ctx.ui.select one, then ctx.fork(entryId) back to it. Record an 'adlc-rollback' evidence entry naming the target. Degrades in non-TUI. Guard: when the session tree API shape differs from the types (defensive optional-chaining), notify 'rollback unavailable' instead of throwing.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: /adlc-accept happy path (fake exec returning behavior-diff JSON + accept exit 0, fake confirm=true) runs both CLIs and notifies the acceptance; confirm=false runs behavior-diff but NOT accept; missing packet path → error notify, no dialog, no exec. VERIFY: node --test with fake exec/ui.
- AC2: session_shutdown with unresolved gate events appends the manifest entry (chain-valid); with a clean session or no ticket it appends nothing. VERIFY: node --test.
- AC3: /adlc-rollback surfaces a select of entry digests and calls ctx.fork with the chosen entry id; select=undefined forks nothing; a sessionManager without getBranch degrades to a notify. VERIFY: node --test with a fake command ctx.
- AC4: full root `npm test` exits 0; live scripts pass.

Suppressions denied; marker fixtures by concatenation. Do not modify sibling plugins or packages/**.
title: pi Phase 4c: P6 integrate (/adlc-accept human gate + session_shutdown capture) and fork-based rollback
